invariant.portable_principle: A high branch score is a read-only structural lead, never a performance or safe-refactor verdict.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Python retains six stdlib-AST heuristic bands.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: JavaScript/TypeScript retain family-local Compiler API syntax facts.

runtime: host Go executable on PATH, Go >= 1.22.0

tooling.selected: go run bundled detect_go_complexity.go using go/parser, go/ast, and ast.IsGenerated

rejected_alternatives.shared_parser: No second Go consumer proves a common runtime seam.
rejected_alternatives.go_packages: Syntax-only complexity does not need package or type facts.

tooling.version_and_resolution: Discover go from PATH; local verification used /opt/homebrew/bin/go go1.26.5.
tooling.closure_mode: The Go launcher stays in the selected skill scripts directory and imports only the Go standard library.

structured_outputs: findings.json with status and Go analysis metadata

known_false_positives: Dense validation or policy code can legitimately score highly.
known_false_negatives: Calls, dynamic dispatch, interfaces, and nested func literals are intentionally not scored.
legitimate_similar_shapes: Build-constrained source produces partial rather than a clean report or platform claim.

did_not_generalize: a universal parser or shared fact platform

evidence: Only this P3 family needs the exact direct-body score and installed closure today.

install_steps: Run scripts/run.py with --language go from the host root.
agent_confusions: A partial build-tag report is not clean.
A score is not performance evidence.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: Add build-context evaluation only after a real host demonstrates that partial tag handling blocks useful review.

residual_risks: Filename platform constraints and cgo are not interpreted.
The fixture does not establish package or runtime behavior claims.

next_decision.recommendation: Keep the detector family-local and use its evidence to evaluate P3 expansion only after the proposal and mutation lanes complete.
next_decision.rationale: The final report, native checks, exclusions, failures, and copied closure are proven without a shared platform.
